name: snagline
description: Understand and operate within a Snagline support fabric's trust boundary: consume the inert case advice an operator-run front or reviewed trusted adapter renders, learn the edge case/advice API, and verify SSP artifacts. An agent never holds the edge socket, UID, or credentials, and no shipped client opens a case.

interface.shortDescription: Operate a Snagline support fabric within its trust boundaries
interface.longDescription: Consume the inert case advice an operator-run front or reviewed trusted adapter renders, understand the edge case and advice API, and verify SSP artifacts. An agent never holds the edge socket, UID, or credentials; case opening and advice finalization happen only through explicitly deployed, externally constrained operator tools.
defaultPrompt: Explain the Snagline trust boundary for an integrating agent.
Show me the advice that came back on this Snagline case.
